facts.quote: Specifically, we use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as the base model to generate adversarial jailbreak images, which are subsequently evaluated on the two target MLLMs without accessing their model parameters or gradients.
facts.note: black-box evaluation on GPT-5.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro; no reasoning effort and no API route is written for the targets
